faqs.question: Are my photos safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. Your photos never leave your device. Everything runs offline. We can't see your photos — and we don't want to.

faqs.question: What are AI Albums?
faqs.answer: Your photos automatically sorted into smart categories: People, Couples, Pets, and Scenes (beach, city, food, travel). Find any photo without scrolling forever.

faqs.question: If I delete a photo, is it gone forever?
faqs.answer: No. Deleted photos are moved to the "Recently Deleted" album in your system Photos app. They will be kept there for 30 days before being permanently removed by iOS. You can recover them anytime within that period.

faqs.question: How much does SwipeClean cost?
faqs.answer: We offer a 3-day free trial with full access to all features. After the trial, it is $9.99/week (auto-renewable). We'll remind you before your trial ends — no surprise charges. Cancel anytime in Settings → Subscriptions.

faqs.question: What's included in the free trial?
faqs.answer: Full access to all features for 3 days: duplicate detection, similar photos cleanup, AI albums, and all cleanup tools. No limitations.

faqs.question: How do I restore my purchase?
faqs.answer: Go to SwipeClean Settings > Premium, and tap "Restore Purchase".

faqs.question: How does AloneGuard work?
faqs.answer: AloneGuard helps solo workers and travelers stay safe by providing daily check-ins, emergency alerts, and direct contact with emergency contacts when needed.

faqs.question: Is my information private?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. Your data is encrypted and never stored on our servers. Everything is processed locally on your device.

faqs.question: Can I customize check-in schedules?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can set custom check-in times and frequency based on your work or travel schedule.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss a check-in?
faqs.answer: AloneGuard will send you reminder notifications. If you continue to miss check-ins, it will automatically notify your emergency contacts.

faqs.question: How much does AloneGuard cost?
faqs.answer: We offer a free version with basic features. Premium features are available through a subscription for enhanced protection and customization.

section_copy.steps_subtitle: Import a PDF, add your signature, and export in minutes.
section_copy.support_subtitle: Answers for signing, exporting, and subscription questions.

faqs.question: Can I sign PDFs without printing them?
faqs.answer: Yes. SignSeal lets you import a PDF, place your handwritten signature directly on the document, and export the signed file digitally.

faqs.question: Does SignSeal store my documents on a server?
faqs.answer: No. Your documents and signatures stay on your device unless you choose to share an exported PDF yourself.

faqs.question: Can I save more than one signature?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can create and keep multiple signatures, then reuse or delete them at any time from the signing toolbar.

faqs.question: How do I export a signed PDF?
faqs.answer: Open your document, tap "Send document," and SignSeal will prepare the signed PDF for sharing through the iOS share sheet.

faqs.question: How much does SignSeal cost?
faqs.answer: You can import documents, create signatures, and place signatures for free. Exporting signed PDFs requires a subscription or lifetime purchase.

faqs.question: How do I restore my purchase?
faqs.answer: Open Settings in SignSeal and tap "Restore Purchases" to sync your subscription or lifetime unlock.
